{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] 
{{recipesummary|category=Sandwich recipes|servings=6|time=20 minutes|difficulty=2}}

==Ingredients==

* 1½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] [[Cookbook:Ground Beef|ground beef]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Chopping|finely chopped]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* 6 strips of [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], cooked well done and crumbled
* 4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounce]] (1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) shredded [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
* ⅓ cup canned sliced [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]]
* 6 split [[Cookbook:Bread|hamburger buns]]

==Procedure==

# Mix beef, garlic salt, onion, and pepper thoroughly in a bowl.
# Shape [[Cookbook:Hamburger|hamburger]] mixture into 6 patties, about ¾-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick.
# Mix bacon, cheese, mayonnaise, and mushrooms together and store in the refrigerator or cooler.
# Cook burgers on the [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]], covered, for 5 or 7 minutes on each side.
# During the last 3 minutes, put ¼ cup cheese mixture on top of each burger.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Serve on buns, if desired.
* And of course, [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]] with [[Cookbook:Lettuce|lettuce]] and [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato slices]].
* Have available the usual: [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]], [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]], and [[Cookbook:Pickle|pickle relish]].
